## Context / Problem
Seven Python modules under `tests/unit/plan_review` contain 10 audited, verbose leading docstrings. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45`; the stable IDs below replace mutable line ranges. The old ranges also selected five short, load-bearing comment blocks that already state current constraints concisely; those false positives are protected rather than edited.

## Approach
Edit only the stable-ID blocks below. Capture immutable before/final blobs for every owned path and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` that is the first statement of a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining normalized ASTs to match.

Tokenize both blobs and reject every changed inline comment or non-allowlisted full-line comment. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_2be7_whitespace_material.py` — 3 blocks:
  - `D:<module>`
  - `D:test_whitespace_only_edit_leaves_attestation_certified`
  - `D:test_legacy_algorithm_still_hashes_the_raw_description`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py`:
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py`:
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py`:
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_floor_module_seam.py` — 2 blocks:
  - `D:<module>`
  - `D:test_det_floor_still_exposes_every_moved_name`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py`:
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_t5c_grounding.py`:
  - `D:<module>`

`D:<symbol>` means the true leading docstring owned by that module/function. No other prose is editable.

## Protected false positives
Keep exact the current full-line blocks before `_MOVED_CHECKS`, `_MODULE_BOUND`, and `_P6_BARE_NAMES` in `test_det_floor_module_seam.py`; before `d = _decided("omits_required_site")` in `test_g7_blocking.py`; and before `text = _text()` in `test_t5c_grounding.py`. They record non-obvious ownership, binding, grading, and cross-rubric constraints in 2–3 lines each.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Whitespace-only material edits remain certified; meaningful indentation/content edits stale; legacy raw-description fingerprints remain byte-compatible.
- Component-specific staleness diagnostics, checkbox normalization, legacy handling, and gate outcomes remain unchanged.
- T3/T10/T5c/G7 posture thresholds, deterministic trigger/skip evidence, grading, grounding, deduplication, and severity scoping remain intact.
- The DET-floor seam retains moved-symbol ownership, same-object re-exports, dependency bindings, acyclicity, order, and size headroom.
- The owned modules are direct pytest inputs. `test_det_floor_module_seam.py` consumes `module_size_support.read_limit`; `test_threshold_recalibration.py`, `test_plan_review_g7.py`, and `test_module_size_contract.py` are included as focused companion/helper consumers. No target module import, `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found.

Preserve this complete directive-bearing physical line byte-for-byte:

```python
    from rebar.llm.workflow import steps as _steps  # noqa: F401 — registers the ops
```

All other inline comments also remain unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; normalized-AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] An independent reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per block: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every expected row has immutable citations and `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing/failing rows block closure.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.
## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest (including named consumers), scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.
